description: Exact decomposition of the mirror proton-excess penalty into an experimental and a model half. Shows the penalty is not one quantity across A: experiment-dominated at A=3, model-dominated at A=7, with the model's asymmetry sign-backwards at both.
q0AnchorReason: q_parameter.Q, the canonical experimental pin; matches the source witness's q0Anchor

context.scope: (a) scope-limited: about the canonical B_pred at these two pairs. Does NOT claim no model can get the mirror asymmetry right, and does not bear on the A=3 mirror-split mechanism of docs/audits/2026-07-13-mirror-split-one-third-mechanism-probe.md, which targets the EM-active channel and records the derived Coulomb/strong ratio tanh(ln q_0) ~ 0.10396 (def:coulomb-charge).
context.why_no_EM_sign: B_pred(Z,N) = E_0*(tr_M(W_free) - tr_M(W_atom)) is a pure Markov-trace quantity with no electromagnetic term, so its mirror asymmetry is purely topological. The sign result is expected; the SIZE is the finding.
context.strengthens: the existing 'magnitude is NOT a single derivable number' verdict — the two penalties are not the same physical quantity, so one derivation should not be expected to produce both.
